Jamie (CEO): Quick note 10am all-hands tomorrow. 35m. Agenda: short company update (8m), product lightning demo (7m), Dedicated checklist callouts (5m), policy blurb on data retention (5m), 10m open Q&A. Please post 1-2 Qs here or use https://tiny.redwood/ah-qs

Nora (People Ops): Invite is out. Reminder set for 9:50am. Hybrid room + dial-in included.

Rina (CPO): Lightning demo will show 2 slides + a 30s demo gif of routing improvements. Will call out rollback plan.

Eli (Eng-SRE): Rolling canary scheduled next Tues. We'll highlight monitoring channels and auto-fallback rules.

Sam (Marketing): I'll have a 20s customer snippet ready. Product please confirm quote by EOD.

Jamie (CEO) [post-call]: Recording: https://recordings.redwood.com/ah-1751234567. Highlights: prioritized reliability and lowering tail latency; demo showed 18% p95 improvement on internal test; Dedicated checklist published; retention default 90d; canary next week. Actions: Eng-SRE publish monitoring playbook; Product + Marketing finalize customer quote; People Ops post slides and notes.

Nora (People Ops): Slides + notes pinned in #all-hands and included in daily digest. If your question wasn't answered live, add it here and we'll follow up.
